evidence_items.evidence_summary: The annual report lists semiconductor equipment covering etch, thin-film deposition, thermal processing, wet cleaning, ion implantation, coat/develop and bonding.
The filing describes separate R&D and product teams for etch, thin-film and MOCVD equipment.
The annual report identifies cleaning equipment as a principal front-end product and also lists electroplating, furnace, coat/develop and PECVD tools.
The filing describes sales and service activities for CMP and thinning equipment, including consumables, spares, installation, maintenance and process testing.
The filing states that revenue and profit are generated by selling lithography-process coat/develop equipment and single-wafer wet-process tools.
The annual report identifies semiconductor metrology and inspection as a core business serving wafer manufacturers.
The filing describes digital testers, probers, temperature handlers and AOI inspection equipment in its integrated-circuit equipment portfolio.
The annual report describes semiconductor-specific temperature-control equipment and proprietary refrigeration, precision-control and energy-saving technologies.
